title: Long-term Safety and Effectiveness of Growtropin®-II Treatment in Children With Short Stature
brief_summary: This study evaluates long-term safety and effectiveness of Growtropin®-II treatment in children with short stature.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Children with short stature by growth hormone deficiency(GHD) or idiopathic short stature (ISS) or turner's syndrome(TS) or small for gestational age(SGA)
* Children who has official height record at least 6 months prior

Exclusion Criteria:

* Children with Epiphyseal closure
study_population: Short stature by GHD or ISS or TS or SGA
